remarks: Discover the possibilities with this versatile duplex in Santa Ana, featuring two separate living units ideal for extended family living or investment potential. Solar panels add an energy-conscious feature to the property. The front residence offers 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, along with an attached two-car garage for added convenience. The second unit features 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, a bonus room and a charming fireplace in the living room, adding warmth and character to the space. The second unit also has access to the backyard, offering additional outdoor enjoyment.
